text: His new fiancé walked into my cousin's wedding night 25 dancing in her heels till the morning light And me, I couldn't even sit down on the floor for the hubby The only reason I held my head through that shaadi Is what my parlour did, he gave me just the week before So let me take it back to the start Me and Rohan, six long years, never did get wetted What's the hurry? That's all he ever said and I believed him Gave that man my 20s whole Cooked clean, drove his mummy to physio Played my role, planned every birthday while he Needed space and how'd he pay me back, another girl in my place Some girl named Tanya, 24 from his gym Found out through a girl in my DMs all about her and him Dee Dee, I thought you should know Three months later he packed his bags to go Four months on, I wasn't missing him anymore I missed who I thought he was, mostly I was in pain Time no sleep could fix, 32 but in the mirror I looked 50, no tricks, 10 hour laptop days My neck and back on fire, my knees cracked on the stairs Every day I felt more tired, I tried it all Physio, yoga at 6am The sprays, the bombs, the heating pad I bought every one of them Painkillers till my stomach burnt, the ache came right back My body gave up on me the same way Rohan did, just like that Shoulders and stops right there What's going on with you? I broke down right in that chair From her drawer she pulled out a bottle with herbs on it My client who's a physiotherapist put me onto this Not those sprays, not the YouTube NUSK, no 15 Ayurvedic herbs in warm till oil, it goes in deep and slow Dee Dee, I'm not spending more on something that does nothing She looked me dead in the eyes, if it doesn't work Your facials are free for a year 12 years, she never once said that Muscles stayed tight, inflamed a mess, sprays sit on the skin An hour later they're gone Warm oil massaged in slow, gets down where it's wrong No oil fixes your whole life That's true but sleeping without pain Is a good start for you It's called EIS, Ayurvedic Pain Relief Oil Mahanarayan Nirgunthi Ashwagandha In a warm till oil
